evidence: Flat directory structure (max_depth=2, no packages defined)
Single main module (heatmap.py) with procedural main() and many top-level functions
All test files live directly in test/ subdirectory without modular separation
Files import directly using 'import heatmap as hm' rather than modular package imports
Low fan-out (avg ~4.7) and minimal inter-module dependencies suggest monolithic execution flow
Presence of standalone example scripts (numpy_example.py, random_example.py, two_pass_example.py) typical of script-based projects
Classes primarily model domain data (Coordinate, Projection, Matrix, etc.) rather than architectural layers
No evidence of ports/adapters separation or clean domain boundaries
risks: Tight coupling between I/O, business logic, and presentation (e.g., OSM background fetching mixed with core logic)
Difficulty scaling or maintaining as features grow due to lack of modularity
Testing heavily dependent on file system and external dependencies (OSM, GDAL) due to procedural style
Hard to enforce architectural invariants or enforce separation of concerns
